errors.text: The proposed secondary phase is an antiferromagnetic BCC precipitate rather than the experimentally relevant C14 Laves phase.
The hypothesis introduces Cr despite Cr not being part of the specified Fe-Co-Ni-Ti composition.
The cited magnetic evidence reports coercivities of only 14.5-39.4 Oe and therefore does not support the claimed increase beyond 100 Oe.
Exchange-spring behavior is asserted for an antiferromagnetic or weakly ferromagnetic BCC phase without evidence of the required hard/soft magnetic coupling.
